target.purpose: Replace ad-hoc object authorization with an explicit default-deny authority matrix whose wildcard behavior is bounded and auditable.
target.central_bottleneck: New or unfamiliar object types can inherit unsafe authority when role checks are scattered and default behavior is permissive.
success: Object/action authority is expressed through an explicit allowlist matrix.
Unknown object or action combinations default deny.
Wildcard authority is controlled and leaves auditable evidence.

invariants: wildcard authority is bounded and auditable

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the implemented object-authority mechanism; no donor implementation is required to define or operate it.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable authority-matrix semantics may be extracted only with lineage, functional/proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's identity.

nonclaims: reference authorization engineering system, not a production Palantir deployment
